generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: native-detail opaque painted game background source panel, Sundrop Village north.
Input images: Image 1 is the single authoritative exact-coordinate control crop (geometry, region, terrain/path, building/transition/protected/semantic/handoff masks stacked). Image 2 is secondary color/composition guidance only from the approved concept crop; do not copy its softness or any objects.
Primary request: paint a crisp hand-painted 2D JRPG top-down ground-only environment panel for the fixed Meadow master-coordinate bounds x=256..2880, y=3968..5056, exact output aspect 2624x1088 (native bounded panel; no canvas border). Preserve the control crop's route geometry, building footprints, door approaches, interaction clearances, and 128px north/south panel overlap alignment exactly. Use cultivated warm Sundrop meadow: warm green grass, golden-brown packed soil, irregular worn paths, subtle field rows only as low painted ground bands, shallow drainage, tiny ground flowers, scattered low stones and leaf litter, and very soft low contact-shadow accents around live building footprints.
Composition/framing: orthographic top-down with only ground-plane painting, geometry aligned to Image 1; keep every live route, transition throat, NPC/anchor/encounter/pickup pad quiet, dry, flat, navigable, and unobstructed. Keep the southern edge visually compatible with the south panel's shared 128px overlap.
Lighting/mood: warm late-morning light from upper left, restrained value hierarchy, crisp shapes and native-detail texture; no blur.
Constraints: opaque sRGB/RGBA raster; exact fixed panel framing; no baked buildings, roofs, architecture, doors, windows, false doorways, walls, fences, actors, NPCs, enemies, pickups, signs, labels, text, UI, icons, bridges, props, or tall objects. Live building and transition pads are empty low ground with only subtle contact-shadow wear at their edges; never place texture motifs or objects inside them. Preserve broad live environmental/corridor masks as natural terrain with no duplicate baked visual or false blocker. No repeated grid, no tile seams, no generator watermark.
Avoid: perspective, isometric camera, three-quarter structures, hard rectangular crop islands, repeated identical motifs, dense blur, false collision cues, blocked approaches, or any object taller than ground detail.
